## Checklist

- [ ] Lint and typecheck pass, and new code has tests
- [ ] A Prisma migration is included if the schema changed
- [ ] Every new UI string is in both `en.json` and `ar.json`
- [ ] API changes are reflected in the shared Zod schemas and the API docs
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots in Arabic and English
